measures.name: Room Type Occupancy
measures.expression: DIVIDE(SUM('Room Occupancy'[Rooms Sold (base)]), SUM('Room Occupancy'[Rooms Available (base)]))

measures.name: Room Type ADR
measures.expression: DIVIDE(SUM('Room Occupancy'[Room Revenue USD]), SUM('Room Occupancy'[Rooms Sold (base)]))

measures.name: Retail Margin
measures.expression: DIVIDE(SUM('Retail Sales'[Net USD]) - SUM('Retail Sales'[Cost USD]), SUM('Retail Sales'[Net USD]))

measures.name: Discount Rate
measures.expression: DIVIDE(SUM('Retail Sales'[Discount USD]), SUM('Retail Sales'[Gross USD]))

measures.name: Devices Due for Replacement
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Device Risk'), NOT ISBLANK('Device Risk'[Replace Reason]))

measures.name: Replacement Cost
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Device Risk'[Replacement Cost USD]), NOT ISBLANK('Device Risk'[Replace Reason]))
